diverse_plus_causal_target_adaptation.adaptation: one decoder-reproducible SGD update after each fully decoded trace; no future trace labels; no transmitted target-specific weights

interpretation: The learned waveform-probability mechanism transfers materially across independent migrated surveys and improves with training diversity, so it is not merely a Waka memorization effect. However, a substantial domain-transfer gap remains versus training on other Waka positions. Lightweight causal adaptation recovers part, but not all, of that gap. This supports treating Waka as a representative hard-local-waveform failure class while continuing to broaden training diversity and seek a compact universal representation.
limitations: Tui is not yet included in this local training result; a repaired four-survey corpus extraction gate is running separately.
Rates are ideal probability-rate diagnostics with explicit boundary/tail charging, not materialized arithmetic streams.
Model bytes are not charged here; a production claim requires fixed distributed weights or serialized model accounting plus an actual entropy stream.
The causal adaptation experiment updates neural weights online and is a research diagnostic; production speed must be measured separately.
